parts.question: Current AX-17 renal guidance in Germany?

result.answer: Current AX-17 renal guidance in Germany, effective from 2026-09-15, specifies dose modifications based on renal category [E2, E3]. For normal renal function (eGFR >=90), the starting dose is 50 mg OD with a maximum of 100 mg/day and routine monitoring [E2]. For mild renal impairment (eGFR 60-89), the starting dose is 50 mg OD with a maximum of 100 mg/day and routine monitoring [E2]. For moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59), the approved German renal starting dose is 25 mg once daily [E1, E3], with a maximum of 50 mg/day and monitoring to recheck in 2-4 weeks [E2]. For severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29), a specialist review is required for the starting dose, with a maximum of 25 mg/day and enhanced monitoring [E2].
